newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market closes firmer in rush.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market closes firmer in rush.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed stronger on Tuesday, thanks to blue chips moving higher under strong buying pressure.
"Today's favourites were oil refineries and steel mills, as usual, but cement makers also attracted interest," one trader said.
The bullish phase was expected to continue throughout the week, with a market correction forecast for early July.
The independent index BIG OTC, compiled by the BIG brokers, rose by 4.9 percent to 3,196.23 points. Another independent index, CAS-RQ of Creditanstalt Securities, went up 5.01 percent to 734 points.
Both indices are based on average prices and market capitalisation. The VAB-RA index was not immediately available.
But turnover was down by nearly 50 percent in low supply to 13.6 billion lei from 24.6 billion on Monday.

Oil refinery Petromidia closed weaker on profit-taking after several sessions of gains. It lost 500 lei to close at 29,500. Arpechim, another oil refinery, ended 2,500 lei firmer at 30,000 in heavy demand.
Steel mill Sidex gained 1,000 lei to 17,500. Traders forecast a further rise to 20,000 lei by the end of the week.

Another steel mill, Otelinox, a star in the market over past weeks, inched down 200 lei and closed at 34,300. Operators expected Otelinox to stay stable before the State Ownership Fund announced selloff of a majority stake to a strategic investor.
Strong demand moved cement maker Romcim 13,000 lei higher to 90,000. It was seen climbing further to 100,000 later this week.
